faq.q: What is an AI fashion model generator?
faq.a: It shows your clothing or accessory worn by an AI-generated model. You start from one flat product photo and get a styled, on-body image for your store.

faq.q: How does virtual model photography work?
faq.a: Upload a flat garment photo, choose a model and a scene, and generate. The item is placed on the model while its color and cut follow your photo.

faq.q: Which products work on a virtual model?
faq.a: Tops, dresses, outerwear, bags and jewelry work well. A clear flat garment or accessory photo gives the best reference.

faq.q: Is it suitable for ecommerce stores?
faq.a: Yes. Use the worn view on product pages and social posts, and keep a separate plain product photo for details and measurements.

faq.q: Can I choose the model and background?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a general adult look and a styled scene. Do not request a real celebrity, and small differences between results are normal.

faq.q: Does the image prove how clothing fits?
faq.a: No. It shows a styled look, not a measured fitting. Keep verified measurements and a size chart in the listing.

faq.q: Can I run the photo in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Add any price or offer in your ad editor, not on the image.

faq.q: Do the garment details stay the same?
faq.a: Color and cut are kept from the flat photo, but small print or closure details can shift. Compare each result with the real item.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the garment and preserve its color, cut, seams and blank label area. Show an adult wearing it for a full-length outfit check, ending with the garment and silhouette easy to see. Natural fitting-room light, mirror-view framing.
